name: @vssaros/dsh-local-agents
description: VsSaros local agent CLI routes for DeepSeek Harness: registers installed coding CLIs as dsh LlmAdapter model routes, so a Bot can use the CLI's own sign-in and plan. P0 NDJSON + P1 ACP/MCP tool bridge + P2 image input, settings data service and a zero-JS SSR settings page at /x/local-agents/. Default disabled. Zero runtime imports beyond Node builtins.
